As the Crow Carves is a Premium Story Challenge costing 1250 and was added to the game on November 3rd 2026. It is the third Legacy Chronicles story challenge, bringing back redesigns of Mythic skins previously earned by players in the As the Crow Flies Event.

Description
The Plague Doctor becomes a surgeon.
Story
Introduction
Letter. Stained Paper, 5x6 in.
Our dearest Doctor,
A woman came by our humble laboratory to ask for a consultation. She seems a specimen worthy of study: white hair and dark circles, but young. Or perhaps the other way: bright eyes and malleable skin, but old. Alas, she did not wish to subject herself to study and was regrettably firm. She only wanted to know our qualifications.
We aren't suited for the job, but we crowed your praises, though the results of your last surgery speak for themselves. You created such a beautiful beak. The woman seemed very interested. Did we do the right thing, Doctor? Perhaps we should have kept silent. Perhaps we should have killed her for prying. But she didn't try to kill us first. In fact, she seemed to have a great deal of respect for our noble professional, and left peacefully.
Please do keep your equipment ready. Just in case.
Your loyal assistants,
Brood and Bile
Chapter I
Letter. 8x6 in. Paper rolled and bound with a severed crow's foot.
To the one they called the Plague Doctor.
I write you on behalf of my mentor. She seeks your expertise in treating an acquaintance. Mr. Russett is very ill after exposure to the local environment. His life is now ruled by compulsive spurts of blood and violence, which he cannot remember afterward, and no one can prevail upon him anymore.
He will need to change.
Please make yourself available to meet tomorrow at midnight, and we will explain further. Think of it as an experiment: something that pulls us all toward a better future. Perhaps we can use the results for cures against this pestilence you study.
If that doesn't strike your fancy, there is also budget for a handsome reward.
--Sophie Laurent

Challenges
The system for unlocking rewards in Legacy Chronicles is currency-based. Completing challenges rewards Sigils , which can then be spent in the order a player chooses, with each section of rewards being unlocked by spending a certain amount of sigils. Completing all challenges in each chapter is still required to unlock the story and challenges of the following chapter.
